works.title: St. Seraphim of Sarov: A Spiritual Biography
works.author: Archimandrite Lazarus Moore
works.blurb: The fruit of more than twenty years' work by Archimandrite Lazarus, the most complete English biography of the Wonderworker of Sarov, drawing on Russian primary sources and the Conversation with Motovilov on the acquisition of the Holy Spirit.
